scientific_integrity: The generator, boundary conditions, reflection criterion, and strict negative sign are stated with exact definitions. Reproducibility code uses rational arithmetic for decisive assertions, with an explicit logarithm remainder bound; no authorship or external certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: An explicit bivariate strict Archimedean counterexample to PQD implying PMI; neither the converse nor the separate NMI conjecture is settled. No extension to higher-dimensional completely monotone generators is asserted. The sign at the chosen point has a reproducible exact-rational certificate; the global PQD result has an analytic proof. A separate independent scientific priority assessment is outstanding.
title: A smooth Archimedean PQD copula that is not PMI
